title: Figure 10: annotated Airbus A380 flight deck of contemporary aircraft
description: Colour photograph of an Airbus A380 cockpit with coloured callout boxes identifying the "Flight Mode Control Panel," "Primary Flight Display," "Navigation Display," "Vehicle Status Indicators" and "Throttles, Keypads, and Joystick." Captioned "Figure 10. Flight Deck of Contemporary Aircraft," noting it contains displays and controls indicative of those needed in breakthrough-era craft; image source credited to Flickr (September 2007). The page begins a section on the primary flight display.
